Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a fundamental factual error regarding World of Warcraft class abilities and armor types. Specifically, it incorrectly identified the "Demon Hunter" as the class that casts "Metamorphosis" (which is actually a Druid ability) and incorrectly classified the Demon Hunter as a cloth wearer (Demon Hunters wear leather). Additionally, it failed to correctly identify the "Kilt of the Forgotten One" as a Shaman item, instead using it to deduce the absence of a Shaman, while simultaneously including a class (Demon Hunter) that does not fit the armor constraints or the ability description provided. This led to an incorrect final list of classes.
